title: Focus pull
summary: A close-up: a detail sharp and large, a title soft behind it; the focus pulls to the title as the camera eases back, in 4 s.

params.name: detailText
params.description: the detail in focus first: a word or a number

params.name: detailImage
params.description: or a picture for the detail (path)

params.name: title
params.description: what comes into focus behind it

params.name: line
params.description: a small line under the title

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add focus-pull --name my-shot
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-shot/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-shot/scene.html --motion-blur 6
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
The depth of field is real: `cam.focus()` from paper-motion/kit blurs by distance from the focal plane.

values.title: Every frame, on time.
values.line: paper-motion renders what your agent directs.

beats.name: Detail
beats.what: the detail sharp, the title soft

beats.name: Pull
beats.what: focus travels to the title; the camera eases back

beats.name: Title
beats.what: the title sharp, the detail soft

when: one number or one word deserves a close-up
opening a piece on a detail before the name
